Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 한번 더 훈련을 하고 싶어한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 別勉強了，就練到這裡吧。

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No te esfuerces. Ya es suficiente.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não se esforce demais. Já chega.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อย่าฝืนตัวเองเลย พอแค่นี้ก่อนดีกว่า
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jangan memaksakan diri. Cukup sampai di sini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đừng cố quá, dừng lại thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: खुद पर ज़्यादा ज़ोर मत डालो। बस इतना ही।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tu es sûre que ça va ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: แน่ใจนะคะว่าจะไหว?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: क्या तुम सच में ठीक हो?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le di una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đã đưa cho cô ấy một bình Thuốc Hồi Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.

Data.UnitTalk_HIN: आराम करने का फैसला करने के बावजूद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।
